# Phlo Documentation

- [Phlo Documentation](/docs): Phlo is a modular lakehouse platform for ingestion, quality, transformation, orchestration, and data access.
- Getting Started: undefined
  - [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started): Start here to install Phlo, run the example stack, and understand the core platform model.
  - [Installation Guide](/docs/getting-started/installation): Complete guide to installing and setting up Phlo on your system.
  - [10-Minute Quickstart](/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Get Phlo running and see your first data pipeline in action in under 10 minutes.
  - [Core Concepts](/docs/getting-started/core-concepts): Understanding the fundamental concepts and patterns that make Phlo a modern data lakehouse platform.
- Guides: undefined
  - [Guides](/docs/guides): Use these guides to build pipelines, compose services, choose components, and extend the platform.
  - [Developer Workflow](/docs/guides/developer-workflow): This page is the day-to-day developer loop for Phlo.
  - [Choosing Components](/docs/guides/choosing-components): Phlo is modular by design. This page explains the main choice points in the stack and when to pick each option.
  - [Deployment Profiles](/docs/guides/deployment-profiles): Phlo does not have one required topology. It has a core runtime plus optional surfaces.
  - [Data Lifecycle](/docs/guides/data-lifecycle): Phlo is meant to make the data lifecycle explicit, not implicit.
  - [Developer Guide](/docs/guides/developer-guide): Complete guide to building data pipelines with Phlo's decorator-driven framework.
  - [Workflow Development Guide](/docs/guides/workflow-development): ## Building Your First Data Pipeline in Phlo
  - [Data Modeling Guide - Bronze, Silver, Gold Architecture](/docs/guides/data-modeling): ## Understanding the Medallion Architecture
  - [dbt Development Guide](/docs/guides/dbt-development): ## SQL Transformations Made Easy
  - [Data Migrations](/docs/guides/data-migrations): Use `phlo migrate` for table-to-table, query-to-table, or file-to-table data backfills and reshapes defined in YAML specs.
  - [Compose Generation](/docs/guides/compose-generation)
  - [Service Packages](/docs/guides/service-packages): Phlo services are distributed as Python packages. Each service package ships its own `service.yaml` definition and registers a `phlo.plugins.services` entry point for CLI discovery.
  - [Integration Profiles](/docs/guides/integration-profiles): Phlo is capability-driven. It does not require one fixed stack.
  - [Recipes](/docs/guides/recipes): Recipes are small end-to-end slices for common goals.
  - [Phlo Comprehensive Test Strategy Matrix](/docs/guides/testing-strategy)
  - [Logging Guide](/docs/guides/logging): Structured logging for Phlo, powered by structlog with automatic hook-bus routing.
  - [Operations Contracts](/docs/guides/operations-contracts)
  - [Extension Model](/docs/guides/extension-model): Phlo is extended through capabilities, plugins, hooks, and service packages. This page explains when to use each one.
  - [Plugin Development Guide](/docs/guides/plugin-development): Complete guide to developing custom Phlo plugins.
  - [Capability Primitives and Orchestrator Adapters](/docs/guides/capability-primitives): Phlo packages are plug-and-play. Packages publish orchestrator-agnostic specs, and an orchestrator adapter (for example `phlo-dagster`) translates those specs into runtime assets, checks, and resources.
  - [Hook Event Bus Guide](/docs/guides/hook-event-bus): Event-driven extension system for Phlo plugins.
  - [Orchestrator Adapters](/docs/guides/orchestrator-adapters)
  - [Semantic Layer](/docs/guides/semantic-layer): Phlo provides a thin semantic layer abstraction that lets downstream consumers (BI tools, APIs, notebooks) discover and query named models without coupling to a specific transformation engine.
  - [Plugin Registry](/docs/guides/plugin-registry): The plugin registry is a centralized catalog of available Phlo plugins. It provides search, caching, and offline fallback so CLI commands like `phlo plugin search` work without network access.
  - [Dagster Assets Tutorial](/docs/guides/dagster-assets): ## Mastering Asset-Based Orchestration
  - [Discovery And Registry Micro-Benchmarks](/docs/guides/discovery-registry-benchmarks): This benchmark suite measures the plugin discovery and registry cache hot paths used by the CLI/runtime.
- Architecture: undefined
  - [Architecture](/docs/architecture)
  - [Public System Design](/docs/architecture/public-system-design): This page explains the public architecture of Phlo as a platform.
- Setup: undefined
  - [Setup](/docs/setup): Use this section when you are exposing a platform surface, enabling a cross-cutting capability, or wiring Phlo into a wider environment.
  - [Hasura GraphQL Setup Guide](/docs/setup/hasura): Step-by-step guide to configuring Hasura for the Phlo lakehouse.
  - [PostgREST Deployment Guide](/docs/setup/postgrest): This guide covers deploying PostgREST alongside the existing FastAPI service in the Phlo Lakehouse platform.
  - [Observability Guide](/docs/setup/observability): Complete guide to monitoring, logging, and observability in the Phlo lakehouse platform.
  - [OpenMetadata Data Catalog Setup Guide](/docs/setup/openmetadata): ## Overview
  - [Security Setup Guide](/docs/setup/security): This guide covers enterprise security configuration for Phlo, including authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging.
- Operations: undefined
  - [Operations](/docs/operations): Use this section to run, monitor, troubleshoot, and harden a Phlo deployment.
  - [Operations Guide](/docs/operations/operations-guide): Production operations guide for running and maintaining Phlo.
  - [Production Readiness](/docs/operations/production-readiness): Use this checklist before treating a Phlo stack as production-capable.
  - [Local Development Troubleshooting](/docs/operations/local-development-troubleshooting): Use this page when the local developer stack is broken and you need a symptom-first starting point.
  - [Best Practices Guide](/docs/operations/best-practices): ## Building Production-Ready Data Pipelines
  - [Testing Guide](/docs/operations/testing): A comprehensive guide to testing Phlo workflows.
  - [Troubleshooting Guide](/docs/operations/troubleshooting): ## Debugging Common Issues in Phlo
- Packages: undefined
  - [Phlo Packages Reference](/docs/packages): Phlo is organized as a modular monorepo. Each package contributes a capability, runtime surface, or operator tool.
  - [phlo-dagster](/docs/packages/phlo-dagster): Data orchestration platform for Phlo.
  - [phlo-dlt](/docs/packages/phlo-dlt): DLT (Data Load Tool) ingestion engine for Phlo.
  - [phlo-dbt](/docs/packages/phlo-dbt): dbt transformation integration for Phlo.
  - [phlo-iceberg](/docs/packages/phlo-iceberg): Apache Iceberg catalog integration for Phlo.
  - [phlo-delta](/docs/packages/phlo-delta): Delta Lake table-store integration for Phlo.
  - [phlo-pandera](/docs/packages/phlo-pandera): Data quality checks and validation for Phlo.
  - [phlo-lineage](/docs/packages/phlo-lineage): Row-level data lineage tracking for Phlo.
  - [phlo-postgres](/docs/packages/phlo-postgres): PostgreSQL database service for Phlo.
  - [phlo-nessie](/docs/packages/phlo-nessie): Nessie Git-like catalog for Phlo.
  - [phlo-trino](/docs/packages/phlo-trino): Trino distributed SQL query engine for Phlo.
  - [phlo-minio](/docs/packages/phlo-minio): MinIO S3-compatible object storage for Phlo.
  - [phlo-rustfs](/docs/packages/phlo-rustfs): RustFS S3-compatible object storage for Phlo.
  - [phlo-grafana](/docs/packages/phlo-grafana): Grafana visualization service for Phlo.
  - [phlo-prometheus](/docs/packages/phlo-prometheus): Prometheus metrics collection for Phlo.
  - [phlo-loki](/docs/packages/phlo-loki): Loki log aggregation for Phlo.
  - [phlo-alloy](/docs/packages/phlo-alloy): Grafana Alloy log collector for Phlo.
  - [phlo-otel](/docs/packages/phlo-otel): `phlo-otel` translates Phlo hook events into OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and optionally OTLP log records.
  - [phlo-clickstack](/docs/packages/phlo-clickstack)
  - [phlo-alerting](/docs/packages/phlo-alerting): Alert routing and notification plugin for Phlo.
  - [phlo-api](/docs/packages/phlo-api): Backend API service for Phlo Observatory.
  - [phlo-postgrest](/docs/packages/phlo-postgrest): PostgREST API service for Phlo.
  - [phlo-hasura](/docs/packages/phlo-hasura): Hasura GraphQL engine for Phlo.
  - [phlo-openmetadata](/docs/packages/phlo-openmetadata): OpenMetadata integration for Phlo.
  - [phlo-observatory](/docs/packages/phlo-observatory): Phlo Observatory UI for data platform visibility.
  - [phlo-superset](/docs/packages/phlo-superset): Apache Superset BI service for Phlo.
  - [phlo-pgweb](/docs/packages/phlo-pgweb): pgweb database browser for Phlo.
  - [phlo-testing](/docs/packages/phlo-testing): Testing utilities for Phlo packages.
  - [phlo-core-plugins](/docs/packages/phlo-core-plugins): Core plugins for Phlo (quality checks and source connectors).
  - [phlo-clickhouse](/docs/packages/phlo-clickhouse): ClickHouse analytical database for Phlo.
  - [phlo-observatory-example](/docs/packages/phlo-observatory-example): Example Observatory extension plugin for Phlo.
  - [phlo-sling](/docs/packages/phlo-sling): Sling-based data replication for Phlo.
  - [phlo-traefik](/docs/packages/phlo-traefik): `phlo-traefik` provides a local reverse proxy for accessing Phlo services by hostname instead of port number.

  - [Auth And Access Model](/docs/reference/auth-and-access): Authentication and authorization in Phlo are layered.
  - [Glossary](/docs/reference/glossary): ## Core Terms
  - [FAQ](/docs/reference/faq): ## Why do we have setup docs for Hasura, PostgREST, and OpenMetadata but not everything?
  - [phlo-api](/docs/reference/phlo-api): Observatory backend API for Phlo infrastructure management.
  - [CLI Reference](/docs/reference/cli-reference): Complete reference for the Phlo command-line interface.
  - [Configuration Reference](/docs/reference/configuration-reference): Complete reference for configuring Phlo.
  - [Plugin API Reference](/docs/reference/plugin-api): Comprehensive API reference for all Phlo plugin base classes.
  - [Quality Checks Catalog](/docs/reference/quality-checks-catalog): Comprehensive reference for all quality check types available in the `@phlo_quality` framework.
  - [DuckDB Iceberg Extension for Ad-hoc Analysis](/docs/reference/duckdb-queries): This guide explains how to query Phlo's Iceberg tables directly using DuckDB's Iceberg extension, enabling fast ad-hoc analysis without going through Trino.
  - [Common Errors and Solutions](/docs/reference/common-errors): Quick reference for resolving common Phlo errors.
